args.description: swings the sword in a fast forward arc, stopping with the blade extended. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves her), always facing right, seen from the side; keep her look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what she holds: no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture.
args.subject_description: a young woman with a long black and red ponytail and red eyes, a closed black and red top covering the stomach, wide black and red sleeves, long black shorts over opaque black tights, black and red boots, holding a broad black and red sword with red ribbons
args.initial_pose: fighting stance facing right, holding a broad black and red sword with red ribbons
